userDetailSheet.pendienteTexto: Waiting for this person to open the link and set their password.

createUserSheet.camposObligatorios: Email, nickname and starting dataset are required.
createUserSheet.soloSuperadminCrear: Only a superadmin can create users.
createUserSheet.usuarioCreadoSinEmail: User created (the email couldn't be sent)
createUserSheet.noSePudoEnviarEmailDescripcion: The activation email couldn't be sent. You can share this link manually.
createUserSheet.mockUsuarioCreado: (Mock) User created and email sent successfully
createUserSheet.nota: The chosen dataset automatically loads starting schools, courses, rates, commissions and payment catalogs. This person will get an email with a one-time link to sign in and set their own password.

usersDirectory.soloSuperadminRol: Only a superadmin can change another account's admin role.
usersDirectory.soloSuperadminEliminar: Only a superadmin can delete users.
usersDirectory.soloSuperadminActivar: Only a superadmin can activate or deactivate users.
usersDirectory.soloSuperadminEnlace: Only a superadmin can activate accounts or regenerate their access link.
usersDirectory.enlaceGeneradoSinEmail: Link generated (the email couldn't be sent to {{nickname}})
usersDirectory.enlaceActivacionDescripcion: Share this link with {{nickname}}. They'll keep showing as "Pending" until they use it to set their password.
usersDirectory.soloSuperadminContrasena: Only a superadmin can reset another account's password.
usersDirectory.contrasenaRegeneradaSinEmail: Password reset (the email couldn't be sent to {{nickname}})
usersDirectory.contrasenaRegeneradaDescripcion: {{nickname}}'s previous password is no longer valid. Share this link so they can set a new one — the account goes back to "Pending" until then.
usersDirectory.contrasenaRegeneradaEmailEnviado: Password reset and email sent to {{nickname}}
usersDirectory.eliminarUsuarioMensaje: This will permanently delete {{nickname}}'s account and all their data (schools, rates, entries...). This action can't be undone.
usersDirectory.eliminarUsuarioAlternativa: If you just want to revoke access while keeping their data, use "Deactivate" instead.
usersDirectory.desactivarUsuarioMensaje: {{nickname}} will no longer be able to sign in. All their data (schools, rates, entries...) stays intact — you can reactivate them anytime by generating a new activation link.
usersDirectory.generarEnlaceMensaje: A new one-time link will be generated for {{nickname}}. Any earlier link stops working. The account won't gain access until they complete it.
usersDirectory.regenerarContrasenaMensaje: {{nickname}}'s current password will stop working immediately. They'll need to set a new one from a new activation link — their data isn't affected.
usersDirectory.soloSuperadminInvitacion: Only a superadmin can generate invitation links.
usersDirectory.enlaceInvitacionDescripcion: Valid for 24 hours, single use. Share it with the person you want to invite — they'll be able to register even if external registration is closed.
